masakari_api_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Masakari API service (e.g., controller node).

masakari_api_port.description: Port on which the Masakari API service listens.

project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name used by the Masakari service user.

service_user.description: Username of the Masakari service user in Keystone.

service_password.description: Password for the Masakari service user (securely set via environment or vault).

user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the service user.

project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the service project.

region_name.description: OpenStack region where this host monitor operates.

transport_url.description: messaging transport URL for RPC communication (e.g., RabbitMQ or other backend).

monitor_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between checks of host health (e.g., via SSH or IPMI).

failure_detection_timeout.description: Time (seconds) to wait before declaring a host as failed after repeated missed checks.

recovery_retry_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between automatic recovery attempts for a failed host.

max_recovery_attempts.description: Maximum number of automatic VM evacuation/recovery attempts before giving up.

auto_recovery.description: Enable or disable automatic host and VM recovery upon failure detection.

notification_driver.description: Primary notification driver to use (e.g., send alerts via Masakari API).

notification_endpoints.description: List of external notification endpoints (e.g., email, webhook).

name.description: Descriptive name of the notification endpoint (e.g., 'slack-alerts').

type.description: Type of endpoint: 'mailto' for email, 'webhook' for HTTP POST, 'log' for logging only.

address.description: Destination (e.g., email address or HTTP URL).

segment_uuids.description: List of Masakari segment UUIDs to monitor. Empty = monitor all segments.

rpc_use_ssl.description: Enable TLS for RPC communication with Masakari API or messaging backend.

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification (used only if rpc_use_ssl=true).

certfile.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (optional).

keyfile.description: Path to client private key for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_insecure.description: If true, skip TLS certificate verification (not recommended for production).

host_name.description: Explicit host name (FQDN or short). If empty, Masakari auto-detects from system.

health_check_enabled.description: Enable built-in health check endpoint for container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes).

health_check_uri.description: Local URI for the built-in health check HTTP endpoint.
